nav.conta_desc: details, password, second factor, sessions and invitations
nav.usuarios_desc: tenant members: create, edit, disable, reset password
nav.tokens_desc: service tokens with scope, restriction and expiry
erro.sem_permissao: this screen requires the privilege {privilegio}, which your session does not have.
campo.login_ajuda: sign-in identifier; cannot be changed later
campo.perfil_ajuda: the profile is the privilege ceiling; a custom role only removes
login.esqueci: Forgot your password? Ask your tenant administrator.
login.inquilino_inexistente: tenant "{slug}" not found; check the address or enter the tenant
login.so_externo: this tenant signs in only through the organization login
login.muitas_tentativas: too many attempts; wait a minute
login.desafio_expirado: the challenge expired; sign in again with your password
conta.login_externo: this account signs in through the organization login; password and second factor belong to the provider
conta.pendencia_senha: your password is temporary; change it to continue.
conta.pendencia_2fa: the tenant requires a second factor; enable it to continue.
conta.apos_pendencia: available after the pending account item is resolved
conta.foto_ajuda: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 1 MB; the image is cropped to a 200×200 frame
conta.idioma_ajuda: applied right away on this screen and remembered in the next sessions and on the public screens
conta.visibilidade_inquilino: Visible to everyone in the tenant
senha.trocada: password changed; the other sessions were ended
senha.regra_base: at least {n} characters, with a letter and a digit
senha.nao_atende: does not meet the rule yet
senha.nao_atende_regra: the password does not meet the rule: {regra}
2fa.desligado_texto: no second factor: signing in depends on the password alone.
2fa.exigido_texto: the tenant requires a second factor; enable it with an authenticator app (TOTP).
2fa.ligado_texto: second factor on: signing in asks for the password and the authenticator app code.
2fa.sem_codigos: no recovery code left; generate new ones.
2fa.obrigatorio_inquilino: the tenant requires a second factor; it cannot be turned off.
2fa.instrucao: scan the QR in the authenticator app or type the secret; then enter the generated code.
2fa.codigos_uma_vez: recovery codes: shown only once; keep them. Each one is good for one sign-in.
usuarios.buscar: search by login, name or e-mail
usuarios.redefinir_confirma: generate a temporary password for {login}? Their sessions will be ended and they change the password at first sign-in.
usuarios.desligar_2fa_confirma: turn off the second factor of {login}? Their sessions will be ended.
usuarios.senha_temporaria_texto: temporary password of {login}; the user changes it at first sign-in.
usuarios.rodape: recommendation: keep two active administrators; the password lockout also applies to administrators
grupos.vazio_meus: you are not a member of any group
grupos.vazio_inquilino: no visible group in the tenant
grupo.atualizacao_ajuda: members edit the items shared with the group; set only at creation; requires joining by invitation or request
grupo.administrativo_ajuda: members cannot leave on their own
grupo.protegido_nao_apaga: protected group: turn protection off before deleting.
grupo.nao_sai_administrativo: administrative group: only the owner or a manager removes members.
grupo.membros_so_membros: the member list is visible only to active members.
grupo.sem_membro_para_dono: there is no other active member to receive the group.
grupo.apagar_confirma: delete the group {nome}? Items shared with it stop being shared; the items remain.
grupo.convidar_buscar: search user by login or name
papeis.vazio: no custom role; the four profiles act as default roles
papeis.perfil_texto: the profile is the ceiling: a custom role can only contain privileges from this set.
papeis.privilegios_ajuda: the minimum profile is computed by the server; an administrative privilege requires the administrator profile; you only grant what your session has
papeis.nao_tem_privilegio: your session does not have this privilege; it cannot grant it
tokens.rodape: the token is shown only once, at creation and renewal; revocation takes effect immediately
token.escopos_ajuda: a scope without :<uuid> covers all layers; tenant administration only for the administrator profile
token.renovar_confirma: renew {nome}? A new token is created with the same scopes; the old one remains valid for 24 more hours.
token.revogar_confirma: revoke {nome}? Whoever uses it gets 401 on the next call.
token.uma_vez: the token is shown only once; copy it now.
token.antigo_expira: the previous token remains valid until {quando}
token.referer_ajuda: one per line, such as https://gis.example.gov or https://*.example.gov; empty = any origin
token.ip_ajuda: one per line, such as 10.0.0.0/8 or 203.0.113.7; empty = any IP
erro_api.so_admin_altera_admin: only an administrator changes an administrator
nav.conteudo_desc: item catalog: layers, maps, apps, files; folders, search and sharing
catalogo.buscar: search by title, tags, summary or field:value
catalogo.busca_f_termos_faz: all the words, accent-insensitive and stemmed (municipality finds Municipality and municipalities)
catalogo.busca_f_operadores_faz: OR alternates, NOT or - excludes, parentheses group
catalogo.busca_f_exato_faz: equal value (owner login, type name, uuid); an invalid value is refused
catalogo.busca_f_data_faz: ISO 8601; * leaves one side open (modified:[2026-08 TO *])
catalogo.busca_ex_criado: created in Q1 and shared with the tenant
catalogo.busca_erro_sem_campo: colon with no field before it
catalogo.busca_erro_data: date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, or *
catalogo.aproximado: no exact result; showing results similar to "{q}"
catalogo.ordem_padrao: default (relevance with a search; modified without)
catalogo.vazio: no item; create one in "New item" or ask whoever publishes for access
catalogo.vazio_filtro: no item with this search, folder or filter
catalogo.selecao_limite: at most {max} items at a time; refine the filter
catalogo.compartilhar_lote_ajuda: applies the level to all selected items; groups and links are per item, in each item's panel
catalogo.nivel_sem_privilegio: your session does not have the privilege for this level
catalogo.publico_desligado: the tenant does not allow public items
catalogo.sem_grupos: you are not in any group where you can share
catalogo.grupo_sem_contribuicao: you do not contribute in this group
catalogo.erro_sem_contribuicao: you cannot contribute in the group {grupo}
catalogo.dependencias_texto: layers and data this item uses, with each one's level; tick to apply the same level. Nothing is lowered or raised without this tick.
catalogo.dependencia_sem_edicao: you do not edit this item; its owner decides its level
catalogo.links_texto: whoever has the link reads the item without signing in; revoking takes effect immediately
catalogo.link_uma_vez: the address is shown only once; copy it now.
catalogo.link_invalido: this link does not exist or was revoked ({codigo})
catalogo.tags_ajuda_editor: Enter or comma adds; up to {max}
catalogo.tags_nada: enter tags to add or a tag to rename
catalogo.f_bbox_ajuda: xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax in degrees (EPSG:4326)
catalogo.status_ajuda: authoritative is administrator-only and turns protection on; deprecated ranks lower in search and shows the badge
catalogo.pasta_apagar_confirma: delete the folder {nome}? Only an empty folder can be deleted.
catalogo.pasta_nao_vazia: the folder has {itens} item(s) and {pastas} subfolder(s); move the content first
catalogo.upload_texto: the file goes up in parts and the server checks the content against the type; up to {max}
catalogo.arquivo_enviado: file {nome} uploaded; the item was created
catalogo.item_inexistente: item does not exist or no access
catalogo.abrir_em_futuro: opening in {destino} is delivered by the viewer line; the catalog only registers the item
catalogo.descricao_ajuda: Markdown; the server converts it and removes dangerous HTML
catalogo.item_oculto: item without access for your session
catalogo.erro_tag: each tag up to {max} characters, no comma
catalogo.erro_url: URL must start with http:// or https://
catalogo.erro_extent: extent is xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax in degrees, with xmin < xmax and ymin < ymax
catalogo.dados_texto: fields of type {tipo} (schema version {versao}); the server validates against the JSON Schema
catalogo.dados_erro_desconhecido: field not foreseen in the schema
catalogo.versao_conflito: someone else edited the item; reload before saving
catalogo.transferir_texto: transfer {n} item(s) to another user of the tenant; the pre-check lists what fails before running
catalogo.transferir_buscar: search the new owner by login or name
catalogo.transferir_adicionar_grupos: add the new owner to the groups the item is shared with
catalogo.transferir_parcial: Transfer only the ones without failure
catalogo.falha_novo_dono_sem_contribuica: new owner does not contribute in the group
catalogo.miniatura_ajuda: PNG, JPEG or GIF up to 10 MB; the server generates 600×400 and drops metadata
catalogo.miniatura_gerando: job {job} queued; the thumbnail appears when it finishes
catalogo.miniatura_demora: the job has not finished yet; see it in Tasks
catalogo.tipo_sem_gerador: this type does not generate a thumbnail by job; upload an image
catalogo.sem_permissao_compartilhar: your session does not share this item
catalogo.apagar_confirma: delete {titulo}? The item goes to the trash for 30 days and can be restored with the same uuid.
catalogo.apagar_n_confirma: delete {n} item(s)? They go to the trash for 30 days.
catalogo.apagar_obsoleto_dica: recommendation: mark as deprecated before deleting an item others use
catalogo.apagar_dependentes: {n} item(s) depend on this one and would be deleted with it
catalogo.dependentes_ocultos: {n} dependent(s) without access for your session; no cascade is possible
catalogo.apagar_protegido: protected item: turn protection off in the Settings tab before deleting
catalogo.lixeira_texto: items stay {dias} days in the trash and are then purged
catalogo.esvaziar_nao_confirmado: confirmation text differs; nothing was deleted
catalogo.versoes_texto: every edit records an immutable version; restoring creates a new version
catalogo.restaurar_versao_confirma: restore version {n}? A new version is created with its content.
nav.mapa_desc: local basemap in MapLibre, layers and navigation
nav.conexoes_desc: connections to external services: health, history and published layers with provenance
mapa.erro_biblioteca: map library did not load (MapLibre or PMTiles missing)
nav.organizacao_desc: name, visual identity, default map, quotas and password/2FA policy of the tenant
org.logo_ajuda: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 1 MB; the image is fitted to a 300×300 frame
org.mapa_ajuda: center, zoom and basemap a new map opens with in this tenant
org.seguranca_ajuda: the same policy /conta already shows to each member when changing the password (tenant.config.auth)
org.senha_historico: do not repeat the last N passwords
org.senha_expira_dias: password expires in N days (0 = never)
org.exigir_2fa: require a second factor (2FA) from every member
org.dominios_email: allowed e-mail domains (one per line; empty = any)
org.erro_carregar: could not load the organization settings
smtp.ajuda: member invitations, password resets and notices go out through this server; without SMTP those flows fall back to the manual path (temporary password shown to the admin)
smtp.origem_nenhum: no SMTP configured — manual path active
smtp.host_ajuda: empty removes this tenant's SMTP and goes back to the installation's (if any)
smtp.senha_ajuda: a password is already set; fill in only to change it
smtp.erro_carregar: could not load the SMTP settings
convite.ajuda: creates the account when the invitee accepts; without SMTP the link is available here to pass on manually
convite.criado_sem_smtp: invitation created; without SMTP, pass on the link below
aceitar_convite.concluido: Account created. You can sign in now.
aceitar_convite.sem_token: incomplete link: the invitation token is missing
aceitar_convite.invalido: this invitation does not exist or can no longer be used
aceitar_convite.usado: this invitation was already used or was cancelled
redefinir_senha.solicitar_ajuda: enter the tenant and the registered e-mail; if an account exists with that e-mail, we will send a link
redefinir_senha.solicitado: If an account exists with that e-mail, a link was sent. Check your inbox.
redefinir_senha.concluido: Password changed. You can sign in now.
redefinir_senha.invalido: this link does not exist or can no longer be used
upload.dropzone: drag the file here or click to choose
upload.arquivo_pronto: the file is in storage and ready to become an import in /conteudo
upload.tipo_desconhecido: could not recognize the file type; choose one from the list
estado.vazio_texto: there are no records to show yet
estado.erro_texto: try again; if it persists, give the reference to support
estado.negado_texto: your account does not have the privilege to see this area; ask an administrator for access
estado.sem_rede: could not reach the server; check the connection
guia.intro: every variation of the design system, rendered for real with the live tokens; what you see here is what you see in the product
guia.dialogo_texto: Dialog body with sample text. Focus stays trapped here until closed.
guia.toast_texto_erro: could not save; the API answered 409
guia.campo_erro: invalid value: use only letters and digits
guia.painel_corpo: panel body, with the same chrome as the map viewer
guia.estado_negado_texto: example of a denied area: the account lacks membros.ver
nav.estilo_guia_desc: design system tokens and components, rendered live
nav.uploads_desc: upload large files with resume; becomes a catalog item
login.codigo_recuperacao_formato: copy the code as it appears in the list (letters, digits and hyphen)
login.codigo_ajuda: 6 digits from the authenticator app; changes every 30 seconds
login.codigo_recuperacao_ajuda: one of the codes kept when the second factor was turned on; each is good for one sign-in
login.inquilino_ajuda: your organization's short address, as it appears in the invitation
aceitar_convite.login_ajuda: lowercase letters, digits and . _ @ - ; starts with a letter or digit; cannot be changed later
aceitar_convite.login_invalido: use only lowercase letters, digits and . _ @ - , starting with a letter or digit
aceitar_convite.pedir_novo: ask whoever sent it for a new invitation
senha.regra_generica: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit; the organization may require more
senha.curta: the password needs at least {n} characters
conta.idioma_aplicado: language applied in this and the next sessions
2fa.passo_1: 1. open the authenticator app (any that generates TOTP codes) and scan the QR, or type the secret
2fa.passo_2: 2. enter the 6-digit code the app shows now
2fa.passo_3: 3. keep the recovery codes, which are shown only once
